name: ckam-release-0df67d3
purpose: CKAM release: movement redesign releases 1-3 (simple Move, moves between companies with a fixed owner company and an admin correction, repair vendors as places with a Repairs screen)
release_sha_note: release_sha / release_sha_short repeat release_commit / release_commit_short because ops/windows/deploy_ckam.ps1.template reads these two names to check that the package is the release it was asked to deploy
code_identical_note: backend/constraints.txt (44 pins), backend/alembic.ini, backend/pyproject.toml and ops/windows/* are byte-identical to 0b8c525. Changed: backend/app (movement rules, owner correction, repairs, two migrations) and the frontend.
built_from: git archive of the committed tree 0df67d3 (no working-tree or untracked files)
frontend_build: npm ci; VITE_APP_VERSION=0df67d3 npm run build; npm run check:build
database_change: TWO migrations on top of production's c6e8a0b2d4f6, run by `alembic upgrade head` in one transaction.

migrations_in_order.what: release 2: trigger forbid_asset_identity_change refuses asset_code always and company_id / cost_center_id unless the audited owner correction switches its marker on
release 3: asset_user.vendor_id (FK to vendor), one repair place per vendor per company (unique partial index), type REPAIR_VENDOR allowed, a repair place needs no location

migration_notes.one_transaction: A failed upgrade rolls back both and leaves the database at c6e8a0b2d4f6 (confirm with alembic current).
migration_notes.old_release_on_new_schema: The previous release 0b8c525 does not know the new trigger rules (owner correction) or repair places. Do not use it as a quick rollback after the migrations have run: roll forward (fix and redeploy); a database restore from the pre-deploy dump only by owner decision.
migration_notes.never: Never start release 3b5e842 or older: it has the IF-01 file-read hole and cannot move assets on the current schema.

components.backend/app/: production backend code incl. app/alembic (migrations); no tests, no __pycache__
components.backend/scripts/create_owner.py: one-time first-owner bootstrap script (only script shipped)
components.frontend-dist/: built frontend (no source maps, self-hosted fonts)
components.ops/windows/: reference launcher, deploy, verify and rollback scripts + README (unchanged)
components.ops/db/: role-split, verify and least-privilege check SQL + runbook, for the DBA (not used by this deploy)

zip_sha256: not stored inside the zip (a file cannot contain its own hash): see MANIFEST.0df67d3.sha256.txt next to the zip, which lists the SHA-256 of the zip and of every file in this folder
